entry.title: Awesome Deno Updates on May 11 - May 17, 2026
entry.content:
Modules / CLI utils

  • cli-spinner (⭐57) - Show spinners in the terminal while running long tasks.
  • cliffy (⭐1.2k) - The complete solution for building interactive command-line tools.

Modules / Database

  • deno_mongo (⭐512) - MongoDB database driver.
  • maxminddb (⭐18) - A library that enables the usage of MaxmindDB geoIP database files

Modules / Markdown

  • LiteMarkup (⭐2) - AST-first parser. Under 3 KB gzipped, zero dependencies.

Modules / Social Platform APIs

  • discordeno (⭐943) - Discord API library for Deno
  • grammY (⭐3.8k) - Telegram Bot API framework for Deno.

Modules / Template engine

  • eta (⭐1.8k) - Fast, lightweight, and configurable embedded template engine.

Modules / Testing

  • superdeno (⭐123) - Super-agent driven library for testing Deno HTTP servers.

Modules / Utils

  • croner (⭐2.6k) - Cron library with advanced scheduling features, well-documented API, and zero dependencies.
  • PLS (⭐9) - Use 2 lines to persist localStorage in any database, including, but not limited to, MongoDB, PostgreSQL and Redis.
  • rubico (⭐283) - 🏞 [a]synchronous function composition; it just works.

Modules / Web framework

  • drash (⭐1.1k) - A REST microframework for Deno's HTTP server with zero dependencies.

Modules / Web utils

  • graphql-tag (⭐8) - GraphQL schema AST from template literal.

Modules / Webview

  • webview (⭐1.6k) - Deno bindings for webview, a tiny library for creating web-based desktop GUIs.

Showcases / Webview

  • Deno Rest (⭐163) - A Boilerplate for deno RESTful apis.

Tools / Webview

  • denopkg (⭐238) - An easier way to use code from GitHub in your Deno project.
  • dvm
    • asdf-community/asdf-deno (⭐132) - Deno plugin for asdf
    • justjavac/dvm (⭐714) - Deno Version Manager: manage multiple active Deno versions.
    • ghosind/dvm (⭐52) - A lightweight Deno Version Manager for Linux/MacOS.
  • pup (⭐197) - Advanced process manager for Deno. With autorestart, fs watch, cron start, process telemetry, ipc, clustering, load balancer and more.
